title: Invertibility of the fixed evaluation mate
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a morphism of schemes f:X→Y, any universal derived direct-image datum d:Direct l E f of [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data], and every n≥0, the right adjunction mate under d.adj and finiteAdj l E f n of the inverse of pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f n is an isomorphism of functors. This is only invertibility of an already specified natural transformation; no choice of comparison, unit equation, counit equation, or quotient-transition equation is part of the conclusion.

proof.text: Use the finite-extension left adjoint to evaluation. On a flat-term K-flat representative its components at q≤n are quotient tensor, and its components at q>n vanish. Exact geometric inverse image commutes with this extension: it preserves the quotient presentation and the same pure-tensor map intertwines the horizontal restriction and differentials. Deriving gives an invertible extension/pullback comparison without quotient flatness.

Transpose the invertible extension comparison through the two extension/evaluation adjunctions. The resulting right-adjoint comparison is invertible by Yoneda. Its inverse-image square on cochains is the cochain normalization defining pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation. The factors field of d identifies its inverse factors, and the transpose field of d.model identifies its adjunction with d.adj. Uniqueness of localization and adjunction transposition therefore identifies this isomorphism with the displayed mate.

lean.statement:
theorem integralDirectEvaluationMate_invertible {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (d : Direct l E f) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (mateEquiv d.adj (finiteAdj l E f n)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f n).inv)).natTrans
